name: moc-packets
description: Build a management of change (MOC) packet from a proposed process change, design specification, site MOC form and affected-document export. Returns a before/after table, a clause-to-evidence matrix against OSHA PSM 1910.119(l), PSSR and EPA RMP 68.75, an open-items register for documents, training and authorizations, and an attribute-by-attribute comparison for replacement-in-kind questions. Works from pasted or exported data and supports the qualified engineer's and process safety reviewer's sign-off.
